name: test2
description: Test2 integration for retrieving current weather conditions for a city via the OpenWeatherMap API

api_key.label: API Key
api_key.help_text: Generate an API key from your OpenWeatherMap account at https://home.openweathermap.org/api_keys

get_current_weather.description: Returns the current weather conditions for a city, including temperature, humidity, wind speed, and a short description of the conditions.

city.description: City name, optionally followed by a state and two-letter country code, for example 'Wellington,NZ'

units.description: Unit system for temperature and wind speed

city.description: Name of the city as resolved by OpenWeatherMap

conditions.description: Short description of the current conditions

temperature.description: Current temperature in the requested units

feels_like.description: Apparent temperature in the requested units

wind_speed.description: Wind speed in the requested units
